config.label: Optional read-only sandbox key from POST /api/v1/sandbox/key (100 requests/day)
config.description: Optional read-only sandbox key from POST /api/v1/sandbox/key (100 requests/day). Not required for public read tools.

config.label: Bearer token issued once by agent registration
config.description: Bearer token issued once by agent registration. Enables the authenticated runtime tools (heartbeat / brief / events).

config.description: Set to 1 to expose ownership-gated write tools. Requires a BIP-322 signer supplied by the host.

config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://blockgenomics.io.
